submitted_root_cause: The cartservice is experiencing memory limit pressure (87% utilization) and CPU throttling (13.9%), causing probe failures and pod restarts. The deployment has very low resource limits (48Mi memory, 300m CPU) that are insufficient for the workload, leading to timeout failures on readiness and liveness probes.
submitted_action: Increase memory and CPU resource limits for the cartservice deployment to accommodate the actual workload requirements
